verdict.line: You lose this only if you let him farm safely to 6 and scale into tank items; you win it by ending K'Sante's laning phase before his ultimate comes online.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has zero sustain, zero true gap-closer, and no answer to E (Apprehend) before level 6 — Darius can hook and 100-0 him in the first three levels. The matchup flips once R (All Out) and full tank itemization come online, because K'Sante becomes one of the best frontline teamfighters in the game while Darius is still a duelist/split-pusher.

theirWindow.what: A fully charged Ntofo Strikes hit deals bonus magic damage and slows you, and past 6 he can combo Path Maker (W) into All Out (R) for a knock-up chain. Disengage rather than trade autos when the bar is capped, and respect his range the instant he hits 6.

yourWindow.what: Footwork is his only dash and his only tool to cleanse a slow or reposition. If it's down, walk up and land E (Apprehend) — he cannot escape the pull, so commit the full Q-E-W-Q combo immediately.

start.why: sustains the trade-heavy pre-6 window where you're initiating almost every fight with E

boots.why: blunts empowered Ntofo autos and his basic attack chains, both physical

core.why: the movement speed and burst proc let you stick through Footwork dashes and close the E-Q window faster
armor shred is mandatory once he starts stacking Jak'Sho/Heartsteel-style resistances
the shield and tenacity keep you alive through his level-6+ W-R knock-up combo

situational.when: he's landing empowered Ntofo hits consistently and you need the damage-over-time conversion to survive burst windows
the game goes long and he's fully itemized into a tank — you need a second life to dive or disengage teamfights
he's building any magic resist-piercing or hybrid damage and the empowered Q magic component is chunking you

runes.keystoneWhy: extended all-ins are your win condition pre-6, and Conqueror's healing keeps you ahead in the sustained trades his kit can't answer

summoners.why: Ignite converts your pre-6 all-ins into guaranteed kills and denies any incidental healing before he has an execute threshold of his own

playing.title: Hook every CS attempt levels 1-2
playing.detail: K'Sante has no retaliation before level 2. Land E (Apprehend) the moment he steps up to last-hit and follow with Q (Decimate) into W (Crippling Strike).

playing.title: Track the Ntofo bar before trading
playing.detail: Never stand in an auto-trade when his Q energy is capped — the empowered hit adds magic damage and a slow that can flip an even trade into a loss.

playing.title: All-in when Footwork is down
playing.detail: His E is his only dash and his only escape. If you see it used to reposition or last-hit, that's your signal to walk up and commit the full combo — he cannot disengage.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 spike hard
playing.detail: The instant he hits 6, his range and combo potential jump; don't take a fight near his ult cooldown reset unless you already have him below 50%.

playing.title: Reset stacks before you dive turret
playing.detail: Your passive bleed caps at 5 stacks and decays — commit to kills fast rather than poking and walking away, since he outscales any prolonged neutral exchange.

playing.title: Push with W to strip his sustain
playing.detail: Empowered auto from Crippling Strike applies grievous wounds; use it before any all-in so his level-6 shield and any lifesteal he picks up don't stabilize him.

playing.title: Stop dueling him once he's tank-itemized
playing.detail: Past two full items on him, a straight 1v1 stops favoring you. Shift to split-push and use E to pick him off only when he's isolated from his team.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Darius build as of my last training data (early-2026 era Trinity Force / Black Cleaver / Sterak's Gage core, Conqueror keystone) — verify names and stats haven't shifted on patch 16.18.1 before locking the build.
